changes.text: AppInstallation.publication is deprecated: Use the root-level `publications` query instead.

AvailableChannelDefinitionsByChannel.channelDefinitions is deprecated: Use [`QueryRoot.orderAttributionDefinitions`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/queries/orderAttributionDefinitions) and select `id`, `handle`, `displayName`, and `icon` instead.

ChannelInformation.app is deprecated: Use [`Order.attribution`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/Order#field-Order.fields.attribution) for order attribution, or [`Order.app`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/Order#field-Order.fields.app) and [`Order.publication`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/Order#field-Order.fields.publication) for app and sales channel details.

ChannelInformation.channelDefinition is deprecated: Use [`QueryRoot.orderAttributionDefinitions`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/queries/orderAttributionDefinitions) and select `id`, `handle`, `displayName`, and `icon` instead.
CompanyLocation.market is deprecated: This `market` field will be removed in a future version of the API.
Customer.addresses is deprecated: Limited to 250 addresses. Use `addressesV2` for paginated access to all addresses.
Customer.market is deprecated: This `market` field will be removed in a future version of the API.

Customer.smsMarketingConsent is deprecated: Use `defaultPhoneNumber.marketingState`, `defaultPhoneNumber.marketingOptInLevel`, `defaultPhoneNumber.marketingUpdatedAt`, `defaultPhoneNumber.marketingCollectedFrom`, and `defaultPhoneNumber.sourceLocation` instead.
CustomerInput.addresses is deprecated: Use the dedicated address mutations (`customerAddressCreate`, `customerAddressUpdate`, `customerAddressDelete`) instead.
DeliveryProfile.legacyMode is deprecated: Legacy mode profiles are no longer supported. This will be removed in 2026-04.

DiscountCountries.includeRestOfWorld is deprecated: This field is being retired. Discounts that set `includeRestOfWorld: true` will be converted to an explicit list of countries, and `countries` will then return every country where the discount applies.
DiscountCountriesInput.includeRestOfWorld is deprecated: This field is being retired. Use `add` to specify each country where the discount should apply.
DraftOrderDiscountNotAppliedWarning.priceRule is deprecated: Use discountCode and discountTitle instead. This field will be removed in 2026-10.
FeeSale.fee changed type from Fee! to Fee.

FulfillmentService.permitsSkuSharing is deprecated: Fulfillment services are all migrating to permit SKU sharing.
Setting permits SKU sharing to false [is no longer supported](https://shopify.dev/changelog/setting-permitsskusharing-argument-to-false-when-creating-a-fulfillment-service-returns-an-error).
As of API version `2026-04` this field will be removed.
InventoryLevel.scheduledChanges is deprecated: Scheduled changes will be phased out in a future version.
InventoryQuantityInput.compareQuantity is deprecated: Use `changeFromQuantity` instead. This will be removed in 2026-04.

InventorySetQuantitiesInput.ignoreCompareQuantity is deprecated: Instead of opting out of quantity comparison checks by passing in `ignoreCompareQuantity: true`, you can now opt out by explicitly passing in a null value to `InventoryQuantityInput.changeFromQuantity`. This field will be removed in `2026-04`.
Market.currencySettings changed type from MarketCurrencySettings! to MarketCurrencySettings.
MarketCurrencySettingsUpdatePayload.market is deprecated: Use `marketCreate` and `marketUpdate` mutations instead.
MarketUserErrorCode.CANNOT_ADD_REGIONS_TO_PRIMARY_MARKET is deprecated: This will no longer be used after legacy markets are removed in April 2026
MarketUserErrorCode.PRIMARY_MARKET_MUST_USE_PRIMARY_DOMAIN is deprecated: This will no longer be used after legacy markets are removed in April 2026
MarketWebPresence.market changed type from Market! to Market.
MarketingActivityCreateInput.budget is deprecated: Marketing activity app extensions are deprecated and will be removed in the near future.
MarketingActivityCreateInput.context is deprecated: Marketing activity app extensions are deprecated and will be removed in the near future.
MarketingActivityCreateInput.formData is deprecated: Marketing activity app extensions are deprecated and will be removed in the near future.
MarketingActivityCreateInput.marketingActivityTitle is deprecated: Marketing activity app extensions are deprecated and will be removed in the near future.
MarketingActivityCreateInput.urlParameterValue is deprecated: Marketing activity app extensions are deprecated and will be removed in the near future.
MarketingActivityCreateInput.utm is deprecated: Marketing activity app extensions are deprecated and will be removed in the near future.
MarketingActivityCreatePayload.marketingActivity is deprecated: Marketing activity app extensions are deprecated and will be removed in the near future.
MarketingActivityCreatePayload.redirectPath is deprecated: Marketing activity app extensions are deprecated and will be removed in the near future.
MarketingActivityUpdateInput.budget is deprecated: Marketing activity app extensions are deprecated and will be removed in the near future.
MarketingActivityUpdateInput.errors is deprecated: Marketing activity app extensions are deprecated and will be removed in the near future.
MarketingActivityUpdateInput.formData is deprecated: Marketing activity app extensions are deprecated and will be removed in the near future.
MarketingActivityUpdateInput.marketedResources is deprecated: Marketing activity app extensions are deprecated and will be removed in the near future.
MarketingActivityUpdateInput.marketingRecommendationId is deprecated: Marketing activity app extensions are deprecated and will be removed in the near future.
MarketingActivityUpdateInput.status is deprecated: Marketing activity app extensions are deprecated and will be removed in the near future.
MarketingActivityUpdateInput.targetStatus is deprecated: Marketing activity app extensions are deprecated and will be removed in the near future.
MarketingActivityUpdateInput.title is deprecated: Marketing activity app extensions are deprecated and will be removed in the near future.
MarketingActivityUpdateInput.urlParameterValue is deprecated: Marketing activity app extensions are deprecated and will be removed in the near future.
MarketingActivityUpdateInput.utm is deprecated: Marketing activity app extensions are deprecated and will be removed in the near future.
MarketingEngagement.channelHandle is deprecated: Channel-level engagements are deprecated. Provide engagement metrics on a marketing activity using `marketingActivityId` or `remoteId` instead.

MarketingEngagement.isCumulative is deprecated: Cumulative metrics are being phased out. Send non-cumulative engagement metrics instead (values aggregated over the single day indicated in `occurredOn`, with `isCumulative: false`). Existing activities that have been sending cumulative metrics can migrate to non-cumulative at any time.
MediaImage.metafield is deprecated: No longer supported. Use metaobjects instead.
MediaImage.metafields is deprecated: No longer supported. Use metaobjects instead.
Metafield.description is deprecated: This field will be removed in a future release. Use the `description` on the metafield definition instead.
MetafieldRelation.target is deprecated: No longer supported. Access the object directly instead.
MetaobjectAdminAccess.PRIVATE is deprecated: Use MERCHANT_READ instead. Removed in API version 2027-01.
MetaobjectAdminAccess.PUBLIC_READ is deprecated: Use MERCHANT_READ instead. Removed in API version 2027-01.
Mutation.collectionAddProducts is deprecated: Use `collectionUpdate` with inclusion.selectionsToAdd instead.
Mutation.collectionAddProductsV2 is deprecated: Use `collectionUpdate` with inclusion.selectionsToAdd instead.
Mutation.collectionRemoveProducts is deprecated: Use `collectionUpdate` with inclusions.selectionsToRemove instead.
Mutation.deliveryProfileUpdate(leaveLegacyModeProfiles:) is deprecated: Legacy mode profiles are no longer supported. This will be removed in 2026-04.
Mutation.deliveryShippingOriginAssign is deprecated: Single origin shipping mode is no longer supported.

Mutation.inventoryActivate(stockAtLegacyLocation:) is deprecated: All fulfillment services now permit SKU sharing, so activation no longer depends on this argument. It's ignored and has no effect; stop passing it.
Mutation.inventorySetScheduledChanges is deprecated: Scheduled changes will be phased out in 2026-07.

Mutation.marketCurrencySettingsUpdate is deprecated: Use `marketCreate` and `marketUpdate` for creating and updating
market currency settings, respectively. Removed in API version 2027-01.

Mutation.marketingEngagementCreate(channelHandle:) is deprecated: Channel-level engagements are deprecated. Provide engagement metrics on a marketing activity using `marketingActivityId` or `remoteId` instead.
Mutation.marketingEngagementsDelete is deprecated: Channel-level engagements are deprecated. Activity-level engagement data cannot be deleted directly; delete the MarketingActivity instead.

Mutation.marketingEngagementsDelete(channelHandle:) is deprecated: Channel-level engagements are deprecated. Activity-level engagement data cannot be deleted directly; delete the MarketingActivity instead.

Mutation.marketingEngagementsDelete(deleteEngagementsForAllChannels:) is deprecated: Channel-level engagements are deprecated. Activity-level engagement data cannot be deleted directly; delete the MarketingActivity instead.
Mutation.pubSubWebhookSubscriptionUpdate(webhookSubscription:) changed type from PubSubWebhookSubscriptionInput to PubSubWebhookSubscriptionInput!.

Mutation.subscriptionDraftCommit is deprecated: Use the [SubscriptionContractCalculation API](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/purchase-options/subscriptions/contracts/migrate-to-subscription-calculation-api) instead.

Mutation.subscriptionDraftDiscountAdd is deprecated: Use the [SubscriptionContractCalculation API](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/purchase-options/subscriptions/contracts/migrate-to-subscription-calculation-api) instead.

Mutation.subscriptionDraftDiscountRemove is deprecated: Use the [SubscriptionContractCalculation API](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/purchase-options/subscriptions/contracts/migrate-to-subscription-calculation-api) instead.

Mutation.subscriptionDraftDiscountUpdate is deprecated: Use the [SubscriptionContractCalculation API](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/purchase-options/subscriptions/contracts/migrate-to-subscription-calculation-api) instead.

Mutation.subscriptionDraftLineAdd is deprecated: Use the [SubscriptionContractCalculation API](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/purchase-options/subscriptions/contracts/migrate-to-subscription-calculation-api) instead.

Mutation.subscriptionDraftLineRemove is deprecated: Use the [SubscriptionContractCalculation API](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/purchase-options/subscriptions/contracts/migrate-to-subscription-calculation-api) instead.

Mutation.subscriptionDraftLineUpdate is deprecated: Use the [SubscriptionContractCalculation API](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/purchase-options/subscriptions/contracts/migrate-to-subscription-calculation-api) instead.

Mutation.subscriptionDraftUpdate is deprecated: Use the [SubscriptionContractCalculation API](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/purchase-options/subscriptions/contracts/migrate-to-subscription-calculation-api) instead.

PriceRuleShippingLineEntitlements.includeRestOfWorld is deprecated: This field is being retired. Price rules that set `includeRestOfWorld: true` will be converted to an explicit list of countries, and `countryCodes` will then return every country where the price rule applies.
ProductSetInput.id is deprecated: Use `identifier` instead to get the product's ID
ProductVariant.taxCode is deprecated: This field should no longer be used in new integrations. This field will not be available in future API versions.
QueryRoot.currentBulkOperation is deprecated: Use `bulkOperations` with status filter instead.
QueryRoot.marketByGeography is deprecated: This `market_by_geography` field will be removed in a future version of the API.
QueryRoot.metafieldDefinition(id:) is deprecated: This field will be removed in a future version. Use the identifier input instead.
QueryRoot.segmentMigrations is deprecated: Use the migrated segment ID and query `segment` directly.

QueryRoot.subscriptionDraft is deprecated: Use the [SubscriptionContractCalculation API](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/purchase-options/subscriptions/contracts/migrate-to-subscription-calculation-api) instead.
ReturnLineItem.returnReason is deprecated: Use `returnReasonDefinition` instead. This field will be removed in the future.
ReturnLineItemInput.returnReason is deprecated: Use `returnReasonDefinitionId` instead. This field will be removed in the future.
ReturnLineItemType.returnReason is deprecated: Use `returnReasonDefinition` instead. This field will be removed in the future.
ReturnRequestLineItemInput.returnReason is deprecated: Use `returnReasonDefinitionId` instead. This field will be removed in the future.

Shop.channelDefinitionsForInstalledChannels is deprecated: Use [`QueryRoot.orderAttributionDefinitions`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/queries/orderAttributionDefinitions) and select `id`, `handle`, `displayName`, and `icon` instead.

ShopFeatures.internationalPriceOverrides is deprecated: Use the `markets` field on `EntitlementsType`.
Each market entitlement has a `catalogs` field that indicates
whether the shop's markets have access to catalogs and price overrides.

ShopFeatures.internationalPriceRules is deprecated: Use the `markets` field on `EntitlementsType`.
Each market entitlement has a `catalogs` field that indicates
whether the shop's markets have access to catalogs and price overrides.

ShopifyPaymentsDisputeEvidenceUpdateInput.submitEvidence is deprecated: Dispute evidence can't be submitted through the API. Submissions go directly to the bank and are final, so merchants must confirm them in the Shopify admin.
ShopifyPaymentsJpChargeStatementDescriptor.kana is deprecated: This field is deprecated and will be removed in a future release.
ShopifyPaymentsJpChargeStatementDescriptor.kanji is deprecated: This field is deprecated and will be removed in a future release.
StagedUploadTargetGenerateUploadResource.PRODUCT_IMAGE is deprecated: Use IMAGE instead. This resource type will be removed in a future version.
SubscriptionDeliveryMethodLocalDelivery.address changed type from SubscriptionMailingAddress! to MailingAddress!.
SubscriptionDeliveryMethodShipping.address changed type from SubscriptionMailingAddress! to MailingAddress!.
TranslatableResourceType.METAFIELD is deprecated: Query metafields via their respective resource owners and use `Metafield.translatable` to determine which is translatable.
UnverifiedReturnLineItem.returnReason is deprecated: Use `returnReasonDefinition` instead. This field will be removed in the future.
